component.name: Rufus
component.summary: Create bootable USB drives from ISO and disk images

description.p: Rufus is a utility that helps format and create bootable USB flash drives. This is an unofficial port of Rufus to Linux, with a Qt 6 user interface that runs natively under Wayland. It is not affiliated with or supported by the upstream Rufus project.

ul.li: create bootable drives from Windows and Linux ISOs, and from disk images (compressed or not, VHD and VHDX)
customize the installation of Windows 11: no TPM, Secure Boot or RAM requirement, a local account, no data collection
download Windows and UEFI Shell ISOs
add a persistent partition to Linux live drives
check drives for bad blocks and fake capacity
compute the MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 of images
save drives to VHD, VHDX or ISO images, and optical discs to ISO images

description.p: Writing to a drive needs the authorization of an administrator, which polkit asks for once per session.
The first release of the Linux port, based on Rufus 4.16.
